atmosphere: Cold, damp, decrepit, oppressive, moldy smell.
key_elements: Scattered broken porcelain shards and spilled food scraps on the floor
A single crude wooden table to the side
A faint, flickering oil lamp (qing deng) sitting on the wooden table
Broken window with torn paper, letting in cold moonlight
Peeling paint on wooden pillars and doors

lighting_defaults.night: Very heavy chiaroscuro. Faint warm amber glow from the single oil lamp on the table. Cold pale moonlight streaming through the broken east window. Deep impenetrable shadows in the background.

camera_angles.Angle_A: Wide establishing shot of the front hall showing the floor, table, and dark background.
camera_angles.Angle_B: Low angle from the floor looking up toward the table or the window.
camera_angles.Angle_C: Close-up on the wooden table with the oil lamp.
